The '''Adras system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adras]], which was ruled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
